title: Canonical integer representation of an integral varifold with mass domination (step 6)
statement: Assume (hD): every integral n-varifold V on any U ⊆ ℝ^N has, for μ_V-a.e. x, HasDensity n μ_V x k for some integer k ≥ 1 [the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_integral_density_integer]; and (hC): every n-varifold V on any U with locally bounded first variation and Θ^n(μ_V,x) > 0 for μ_V-a.e. x admits θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with IsVarifoldOf V M_V θ, M_V := {x ∈ spt μ_V : V has a tangent plane at x}, such that every x ∈ M_V has a tangent plane with multiplicity θ(x) and HasDensity n μ_V x (ofReal θ(x)), and every μ_V-null Z ⊆ M_V is H^n-null [the frozen statement of the accepted sibling intcpt_canonical_tangent_representation with AllardRectifiabilityTheorem and FirstRectifiabilityTheorem discharged]. Then for every integral n-varifold W on U with locally bounded first variation there is θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with IsVarifoldOf W M θ (M := M_W), every x ∈ M has a tangent plane with multiplicity θ(x) and HasDensity n μ_W x (ofReal θ(x)), H^n({x ∈ M : there is no integer m ≥ 1 with θ(x) = m}) = 0, and ∫⁻ u dμ_W ≤ ∫⁻_{M ∩ K} u·ofReal(θ) dH^n for every compact K ⊆ U and every Borel u : ℝ^N → [0,∞] vanishing off K. Notation: H^n := μHE[n]; G(N,n) := Grassmannian N n; p_S := Grassmannian.project S (orthogonal projection onto S.plane); t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap(projectionLinearMap S − projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P); μ_W := W.weight; ‖δW‖ := variationMeasure W; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of ℝ^n; ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral V → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (k : ℝ≥0∞)) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight x θ ∧ 0 < θ) → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf V {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ ∀ Z ⊆ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, V.weight Z = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) Z = 0) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral W → W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf W {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane W x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n W.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) {x | x ∈ {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} ∧ ¬ ∃ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ θ x = m} = 0 ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (u : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → Measurable u → (∀ x, x ∉ K → u x = 0) → ∫⁻ x, u x ∂W.weight ≤ ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} ∩ K, u x * ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
